setup_logging_basic: setup logging to stdout with a specified log level using the root logger
setup_logging_with_file: setup logging to both stdout and a file with a specified log level
setup_logging_with_hostname: setup logging with hostname included in log messages for multi-node training
review_setup_logging: review the setup_logging function to understand how it configures the root logger and handlers
refactor_setup_logging: refactor setup_logging to support additional log formats or custom handler configurations
